answer: Commit-reveal admission bound to a future beacon. Each new identity posts a hash of (salt, claim) into an ivory ledger, revealing nothing. Two epochs later the beacon emits randomness R; a claim enters the jade pool only if salt < R/2, so signup timing cannot be gamed. Admitted identities pass a cedar liveness probe within 5 epochs to unlock payouts. An attacker seeding N identities locks 0.10-unit deposits over 2 epochs; each survives with probability 1/2, so outlay is 2N deposits against N/2 payout-capable identities, making farming net-negative.
